batches.analysis: The PR adds exception-class error.type extraction but the shared chat, streaming-chat, and embeddings tests still expect the old exact attribute sets. Add the caught exception class to both span and duration-histogram assertions. Duration metrics retain ERROR_TYPE through the existing attribute advice. Shared tests cover library and javaagent clients without changing production behavior.
batches.downsides: Focused tests remain unexecuted because the required runtime JDK is unavailable; this candidate cannot establish passing CI.
batches.summary: Assert GenAI error.type in OpenAI connection-error telemetry
batches.upsides: Preserves exact attribute checks and existing exception/log assertions while covering all three failed connection-error paths and their metrics.

batches.analysis: Frozen CI generated a four-line HttpCommonAttributesGetter.getErrorType default-to-abstract delta and failed because the committed jApiCmp report lacked it. Apply that exact CI-recorded delta; the resulting blob matches the log. Leave the API baseline and compatibility gate intact.
batches.downsides: The local generator is blocked by the missing runtime JDK, so the report was recovered from frozen CI evidence rather than regenerated locally.
batches.summary: Record the required HTTP getter in the API compatibility report
batches.upsides: Records the intentional HTTP API source-compatibility change and makes the committed report match the supplied CI output.

diagnoses.analysis: This is the unchanged aggregate gate, not an independent compilation or test defect. Its frozen dependency jobs fail on the stale API report and the OpenAI error-type assertions diagnosed here. The two candidate batches address those underlying PR-attributable causes; no gate edit or rerun is warranted. Validation is blocked, so downstream success is not claimed.

The frozen build / common / test2 (25, hotspot) job rejects newly emitted error.type in exact OpenAI span-attribute assertions. GenAiAttributesExtractor now falls back to the exception class; the shared chat/streaming-chat/embeddings tests were not updated. The first candidate batch asserts the caught exception class for spans and duration metrics, preserving exact checks and all existing telemetry assertions. The tests could not execute locally because custom-checks requires a newer runtime JDK; this is a proposed repair, not verified passing CI.
